result.title: OmniV-Bench: Can MLLMs Comprehend Immersive Spatio-temporal Scenes?
result.summary: Omnidirectional videos (ODVs) capture dynamic environments with a full $360^\circ$ field of view, providing rich spatial context and temporal dynamics for applications such as virtual reality (VR), augmented reality (AR), and embodied intelligence. Recent multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have made great progress in spatial and temporal understanding, yet their ability to comprehend the immersive 360 spatio-temporal information conveyed by ODVs remains largely unexplored. To bridge this gap, we first introduce OmniV-Bench, a Benchmark designed to comprehensively evaluate the capabilities of MLLMs on spatio-temporal Omnidirectional Video understanding. OmniV-Bench contains 4,123 high-quality ODVs collected from diverse scenes, along with 8,923 human-annotated question-answer pairs spanning 11 fine-grained tasks across three categories, i.e., general, spatial, and spatio-temporal understanding. Extensive benchmark experiments reveal that the spatio-temporal complexity of ODVs poses significant challenges for current MLLMs. To address these limitations, we further propose OmniV-Harness, an agentic harness that enhances ODV understanding through viewpoint-guided evidence initialization and task-relevant evidence acquisition with adaptive tool use. Comprehensive experiments demonstrate that OmniV-Harness consistently improves immersive spatio-temporal reasoning ability of MLLMs. Both OmniV-Bench and OmniV-Harness will be released upon publication.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文构建了面向 360° 全景视频的 OmniV-Bench，含 4,123 段 ODV 与 8,923 条人工标注 QA，覆盖通用、空间和时空理解共 11 项任务，并配套提出采用视角引导证据初始化与自适应工具调用的 agentic harness 来提升 MLLM 的沉浸式时空推理。
AI.relevance_reason: 论文对 MLLM 时空理解的诊断与「视角引导证据初始化 + 任务相关证据获取」的可核查线索，可能与 LVR 中的视觉证据筛选、主动 LOOK 及证据使用问题相关；但其证据获取发生在视频输入与工具调用层面，是否涉及内部 latent 状态的保留与利用仍需核查。
